one_line: A 15-second silent tabletop animation from Israeli publisher Tamnun in which plastic toy animals arrive one by one and crowd around the children's book 'בעלי חיים' on a white background.

hook.visual: A single hardcover book lies on a plain white background, shot top-down; nothing moves for about 1 s, then a toy kangaroo-like animal appears at the top left and more animals arrive.
hook.on_screen_text: None overlaid. Printed on the book cover: בעלי חיים (Animals), מה, איך, למה (What, how, why), תמנון (Tamnun, publisher logo).
hook.why_it_stops_the_scroll: Weak by itself: the first second is a static book with no text or person. Inferred: the scroll-stop is the sudden arrival of toy animals around a colourful cover, and the caption's 'all the animals came to check' line explains the premise. With a 0.05% like rate, the views are probably not driven by the hook (see paid_signal).

beats.observed: Cover only: teal cover with a lion's face, giraffe, snakes, a bird, a chameleon and a manta-like shape. Pale chameleon at top left.
beats.on_screen_text: Cover text only: בעלי חיים / מה, איך, למה (Animals / What, how, why)

beats.observed: A brown kangaroo-like toy appears at top left (1 s). A cream-coloured polar bear toy climbs onto the left edge of the book (2 s). A brown bovine-like toy enters at the top (3 s).
A small white animal appears at the right edge (3 s), a grey animal at the left edge (5 s) and a red rubber snake slides in from the bottom right (5-6 s). Each new animal arrives roughly every 1-2 s.

The red snake slithers up to the lion's mouth by 7 s and stays. A panda toy sits at the top (8 s). A black bear toy climbs onto the bottom right corner of the cover (10 s). The cover chameleon turns more saturated (orange and green) between 6 s and 7 s; cause not clear from frames.

Black bear is fully on the cover; more toys arrive on the right (red-brown kangaroo-like toy, brown bear). A small '6+' round badge is visible near the top-left of the cover. A green sticker with script text is on the lion's forehead area: [unclear].

Crowd is complete: panda, bull-like toy, kangaroo-like toys, white and brown bears, a black ape toy at the top right, snake, polar bear and black bear around the book. Held to the end with no end card, logo or text.
beats.spoken: Whisper returned only 'תודה רבה.' (Thank you very much) over the whole 15 s, most likely a hallucination over music or silence.

payoff: The payoff is the fully crowded book at about 12-15 s, which acts out the caption line (all the animals came to check what everyone is talking about). There is no product information, hook text or reveal beyond the cover.
cta: none. The caption names the series ('מה, איך, למה' - animals) and ends with #תמנון, with no ask, link or question.
share_or_comment_trigger: Very little. No prompt to comment or tag, no human or child, no information to save. Only 41 likes and 6 comments on 77,162 views.
why_it_worked: Reach was large (77,162 views, 116.7x the account median of 661) but response was tiny (41 likes, 0.05%, 6 comments), which suggests the views were not earned by the content itself.
Visually clean and easy to read on mute: white background, saturated cover, a new animal every 1-2 s so something changes for 15 s (observed).
The caption line gives a one-sentence storyline for the toy crowd, and the series name signals a kids' Q&A book; but nothing in the frames adds a hook or an ask.
paid_signal: likely: 0.05% like rate with 116.7x the account median (661 views) points to paid promotion or a boosted post; this is an inference, since the files do not show ad labels.

solo_route.how: 1) Put a printed LumeBook sample on a white table or sheet, phone on a tripod directly overhead. 2) Collect 8-12 cheap plastic animals or the child-hero's favourite toys; film them entering one at a time (hand-moved stop-motion shot in an app like Stop Motion Studio, or short clips with hands cut out in CapCut). 3) Add the missing hook: burned-in Hebrew text in the first second and a final reveal of the hero child's name on the cover. 4) Add a short caption CTA, for example inviting parents to see a free preview.
solo_route.needs: A printed LumeBook sample copy, a few toys, a tripod and a white backdrop; use an AI-illustrated stand-in hero rather than a real child's face unless there is parental consent.

lumebook_version.hook_he: כל הצעצועים באו לראות מי הגיבור של הספר הזה
lumebook_version.concept: A tabletop reveal where the child's toys crowd around a printed LumeBook, ending with the cover showing the hero's name and illustrated face. Unlike Tamnun's version, add burned-in text in the first second and a free-preview CTA.

evidence_notes: Observed: all 16 frames (0-15 s) across three sheets plus frames at 0, 3, 6, 7, 12 and 15 s. Frames are only 360x640, so the green sticker script and fine cover text could not be read: [unclear]. Animation: toys are physical objects with real shadows and plastic sheen, the cover is a printed illustration, and I saw no AI-looking visuals; whether it is true stop-motion or hand-moved clips cannot be told from 1 s sampling. The cover chameleon changes colour between 6 s and 7 s; I could not determine whether this is the cover print, exposure or an edit. Spoken: Whisper's 'תודה רבה.' is not trustworthy, so there is no usable speech transcript. Paid signal is an inference from numbers only (41 likes, 6 comments, 77,162 views, median 661); no ad label is visible. Duration 15.58 s. The caption is Tamnun's text and was not verified.
